general_information.Description: This course is designed to equip participants with the essential skills needed to cultivate innovative concepts and effectively transform them into compelling executions. Through the strategic harnessing of creativity and refined communication proficiency, participants will acquire the capacity to exert influence and reshape perceptions. The curriculum encompasses an exploration of conceptual thinking, mastery of persuasive copywriting, refinement of art direction nuances, and a comprehensive understanding of the diverse array of media crucial for proficient advertising creatives. Participants will acquire the knowledge and expertise necessary to navigate the intricate landscape of creative advertising, especially within the context of the evolving new media landscape.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Students are responsible for completing all exercises, assignments, and labs given by the instructor in class or at home and submitting them on time. - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/gui/Home for up-to-date course information. - Read the textbook in advance

description: This course is designed to equip participants with the essential skills needed to cultivate innovative concepts and effectively transform them into compelling executions. Through the strategic harnessing of creativity and refined communication proficiency, participants will acquire the capacity to exert influence and reshape perceptions. The curriculum encompasses an exploration of conceptual thinking, mastery of persuasive copywriting, refinement of art direction nuances, and a comprehensive understanding of the diverse array of media crucial for proficient advertising creatives. Participants will acquire the knowledge and expertise necessary to navigate the intricate landscape of creative advertising, especially within the context of the evolving new media landscape.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Demonstrate understanding of advertising’s principles, functions, and evolving role across economic, social, cultural, and digital environments.

Identify how audiences interpret products, media messages, and brand communications, and understand how semiotic, behavioral, and data-driven approaches are used to generate actionable consumer insights.
Apply creative ideation frameworks, narrative structures, and text–image rhetorical techniques to develop original, strategically aligned advertising concepts.
Design integrated advertising campaigns across multiple platforms by selecting appropriate media strategies, digital tools, and content formats that align with specific communication objectives

Demonstrate the ability to work independently and collaboratively in academic and professional creative settings, applying critical thinking, effective verbal and written communication, and responsible use of AI tools to develop and present integrated advertising campaigns

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Required Campaign Components 'Students will collaborate in teams of four to six to complete this assignment. Each group will select an existing product or service from a small business, startup, or non-profit organization (NGO) and develop a creative advertising campaign plan that demonstrates both strategic thinking and creative execution. The campaign should be grounded in a clearly defined communication problem and supported by relevant consumer insights. All creative elements must align with the overall strategy and reinforce a unified brand message across platforms. Each campaign must include the following elements: 1. Brand Overview Brief background of the organization, product/service, target market, and competitive context. 2. Communication Problem Identification and Objectives A clear articulation of the key communication challenge or opportunity, followed by clearly stated communication objectives the campaign aims to achieve. 3. Consumer Insight Development Insight(s) derived from consumer behavior, attitudes, motivations, or tensions relevant to the brand and the communication problem. 4. Key Message and Big Idea A concise key message and a compelling Big Idea that guides all creative executions. 5. Media selection and Tactics A cohesive explanation of the campaign’s media selection and tactics, including: - Platform and channel selections - Specific tactics implemented on each platform - Rationale explaining how strategy, media choices, and tactics work together to achieve campaign objectives 6. Timeline and Budget A realistic implementation schedule and a high-level budget allocation. 7. Evaluation Methods Key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics used to assess campaign effectiveness. Creative Deliverables In addition to the creative advertising campaign plan, students must produce sample creative materials that bring the campaign to life. Each group is required to submit at least three of the following creative executions (including but not limited to): - Print or social media advertisements - Posters or digital display advertisements - Short videos or storyboards - Audio clips or radio scripts - Mock-ups for outdoor, mobile, or experiential formats All deliverables must demonstrate coherent creative execution, consistent tone and visual identity, and clear alignment with the campaign strategy and Big Idea. Presentation Each group will deliver an in-class presentation presenting their creative advertising campaign.
assessments.Grading Guide: A detailed report (1500-2000 words) and a PowerPoint for in-class presentation. All sample creative materials should be included as well.
Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, attitude, preparation, and contribution to discussions
